paragraph: Counter Culture's Hologram page offers a separate flash-brew start rather than asking you to chill its ordinary 1:17 filter recipe: 30 g coffee, 335 g hot water and 165 g ice in the receiving carafe. The page's short summary labels the brew time as one minute, while its step-by-step pours continue after the one-minute mark. Treat the detailed pour sequence as the practical guide and record your own drawdown; do not promise a finished iced cup in exactly one minute. These are roaster instructions, not a Coffeedant brew. Checked October 22, 2026. [SOURCE]
sourceNote: Official product page gives 30 g coffee, 335 g hot water, 165 g ice and a longer step sequence than its one-minute summary.

paragraph: Peet's current Major Dickason's listing describes a signature blend sourced from the Americas and Indo-Pacific, with washed and wet-hulled processes. Those are broad component and process categories, not a farm-level traceability claim or a promise that the same countries appear in every bag. If you buy this dark blend for a particular origin, read the delivered package and ask Peet's for the current lot; if you buy it for a repeatable dark-roast direction, the named blend is the more useful identity. Checked October 22, 2026. [SOURCE]
sourceTitle: Peet's Major Dickason's current product attributes
sourceNote: Official US listing labels a signature blend, Americas and Indo-Pacific origins, and washed and wet-hulled processing.

paragraph: A direct Hair Bender subscription is an automatically renewing order, not merely a one-time bag at a lower displayed price. Stumptown's current product page says the selected frequency controls recurring charges and that the account holder can pause, skip or cancel through the account or support. For a new espresso routine, begin with a quantity you can finish, confirm the chosen frequency and checkout terms, and only then compare subscription value with a one-time purchase. This is policy guidance from Stumptown, not a verified discount or delivery promise. Checked October 22, 2026. [SOURCE]
sourceTitle: Stumptown Hair Bender purchase and subscription terms
sourceNote: Product page says subscriptions renew at selected frequency and can be paused, skipped or cancelled through account or support.

paragraph: Stumptown now gives method-specific Holler Mountain starts on its product page: automatic drip uses a medium-coarse grind and about 28 g coffee for 475 ml water, while its espresso guide begins around 19.5 g in a portafilter. That separation matters for a household sharing one bag between a batch brewer and an espresso grinder; one grind setting or ratio will not serve both. The figures are roaster recipes, not Coffeedant extractions or a promise that every basket fits 19.5 g. Checked October 22, 2026. [SOURCE]
sourceNote: Official product page separates 28 g/475 ml medium-coarse drip from approximately 19.5 g portafilter espresso guidance.
